blocks.text: The estate holds 174.3 TiB, almost all of it in the object store (130.3 TiB) and file shares (43.6 TiB). The databases hold 351.3 GiB. The owner has declared all rights established, so this pack concerns cost, condition and preparation.

Priced strategies bound the monthly saving at 1,174.4 USD at list prices, led by tiering of cold buckets at 986.5 USD. These are upper bounds, not invoice savings, and read use of the cold data was not measured.

Database rows need completeness repair and de-identification or aggregation before products use them. Reference data and the content catalogue are the proposed first products. Nothing has been moved, deleted or released.

terms.meaning: Space that could be removed or stored more cheaply once the check named beside it has been done. It is not space already freed, and it is not a guaranteed saving — the monthly figures are upper bounds at list prices.
Nothing new has been written to that bucket or table for more than a year, judged by the newest write date we could see. It says nothing about whether anyone still reads it — that was not measured.
terms.term: Cold (not written for over a year)

terms.meaning: Two objects whose size and storage fingerprint (ETag) match inside the same store. For large uploads that fingerprint is not a content hash, so a candidate must be confirmed by hashing before any copy is removed.
Database rows that are identical in every measured column. 'Normalised' duplicates also match after trimming spaces and case.
A row whose worst column shows damage: text cut short, a placeholder such as 'N/A' or 'test', an invalid format, stray whitespace or garbled characters.

Blank values in columns whose name or pattern suggests they should always be filled (for example an identifier or a date). The database may not formally require them; the census flags them so an owner can decide.
A column that is empty on practically every row: schema carried without data.
A sampled value that looks like an email, phone number, national ID or similar. It is a condition of the data, not a judgement about rights — the owner has declared all rights established.
A cheaper storage tier for data that is kept but rarely opened. Retrieval is slower and carries its own fee, which is why the saving is stated as an upper bound.
Where this pack suggests data should live or how it should be tiered. Every destination here is a proposal for the executive to approve; this pack moved and deleted nothing.
Recorded hours multiplied by the share of two-second windows the admitted music detector did not call music. Silence is set aside first.
The share of labelled windows (or transcript passages) where the model's language label matched the folder the recording was filed under. It is a model reading, not a human verification.
Windows where the language model's confidence fell below its threshold, so it gave no language rather than guess.

A calendar date on which a station has at least one news script in the archive, and the distinct hour slots scripted that day. The archive does not carry a script for every hour of every day; the tables show exactly which days and hours it does.
The retained Akki record (census run, GPU job or database reading) that every figure in this pack is traced to. The appendix lists them; the workbook carries the row-level evidence.

blocks.text: The estate holds 174.3 TiB across three kinds of store. The object store holds 130.3 TiB in 106 buckets and 23.0m objects; file shares hold 43.6 TiB in 16 shares and 1.5m files; databases hold 351.3 GiB in 20 databases and 1006 tables.
40 buckets could not be read, so the object-store figure covers readable buckets only. This is measured coverage, not a complete account of inaccessible sources.

41.9 TiB of the object store has not been written for over a year, across 43 buckets. 7.7 TiB, 5.0% of objects, are duplicate candidates matched on size and fingerprint, which for large uploads is not a content hash.

The tables beside this chapter name each bucket, database table, file share and unreadable bucket. Database strategy bytes are strategy totals rather than table sizes, file-share duplication is unmeasured, and unreadable buckets need reconciling with the provider, not assuming deleted.

blocks.text: The census scores 8 product candidates on dimensional readiness only, which establishes neither market demand nor revenue. This pack proposes reference and master-data licensing and the content catalogue and recommendation corpus as the first two, each needing canonical keys, completeness checks and de-identification or aggregation.

Aggregated channel and telco engagement analytics is the alternative if a buyer leads. The order is a planning judgement and needs a buyer-side review of each candidate against its intended use. Rights are settled and are not a gate.

The executive is asked to approve verification and preparation work, each with a named source, rule and responsible role in the decisions table. The storage decisions rest on 41.9 TiB of cold object data, 7.7 TiB of duplicate candidates and 40 unreadable buckets.

The benefit is bounded at 1,174.4 USD a month at list prices; it is not current spend. The audio opportunity of 529.5 recorded hours needs filtering and language checks first. Nothing has yet been moved, deleted or released.
